title: (MDR) Music Delay Reducer
description: Reduces music delay to 2-5s. Adds track history, skip hotkeys, and full ModMenu configuration.
body:
This mod reduces the delay between tracks from 10-20 minutes down to just 2-5 seconds.

Features:
Default interval: 2-5 seconds.

Configurable via Mod Menu: from 0 seconds to 20 minutes.

Track History & Navigation: Added Skip Forward / Skip Backward keybinds (rebindable, default: Right Arrow / Left Arrow).

Song Memory: Remembers up to 10 previously played tracks - go back to replay a song you liked, or skip forward through ones you've already heard.

Skip Delay Config: Added a new "Skip Delay" setting in Mod Menu (0-5 sec) to control the exact pause when you switch tracks manually.

Dedicated Keybind Category: All hotkeys are neatly organized under a custom "AlwaysPlay" category in your Controls settings.

Language support: English, Russian, Ukrainian. (If you want more languages added, let me know in the comments!)

Planned features:
Custom music loading

Custom playlists with specific playback order

About this mod:
Personally, I just wanted a mod that keeps the music playing constantly, without having to wait 20 minutes for Minecraft to finally "grace us" with the next track. That's why I created this and decided to share it with you.

I know there are already mods that do this, but unfortunately, they are either quite slow to update or have been abandoned entirely.
